name: Martil
hero_subtitle: Mediterranean beach resort near Tetouan — seafront promenade, golden sand and lively summer energy.

overview.title: Where Tetouan meets the Mediterranean
overview.p1: Martil is Tetouan's main coastal outlet: a long sandy beach and a palm-lined corniche on the Mediterranean. In summer the town fills with holidaymakers from across Morocco; off-season it is quieter and cooler by the water.
overview.p2: The wide seafront is made for evening walks — the local 'paseo' — with families, ice cream and views toward the Rif hills meeting the sea.
overview.p3: Pair a morning in Tetouan's medina with an afternoon on Martil's beach. A short grand-taxi ride from the city centre takes under 20 minutes from historic core to coast.

food.title: Fresh fish by the sea
food.p1: Martil is known for fish and seafood restaurants along the main streets and corniche.
food.li1: Fried fresh fish at waterfront restaurants
food.li2: Corniche cafés for mint tea and sweets
food.li3: Ice-cream shops popular on warm evening walks
food.li4: Classic Moroccan tagines with a coastal twist
food.li5: Light beach snacks in high summer
food.p2: Grab a table facing the water just before sunset for the best atmosphere.

1.title: Transport from Tetouan
1.desc: Take a shared grand taxi from the dedicated station in Tetouan. The ride is about 15–20 minutes and inexpensive.

2.title: Summer vs off-season
2.desc: July–August is busy and lively. Spring and autumn offer calmer beach days.

3.title: Sun protection
3.desc: Sea breeze can hide how strong the Mediterranean sun is. Bring sunscreen and a hat for midday beach walks.

q1.question: How far is Martil from Tetouan?
q1.answer: About 10 km east of Tetouan — 15 to 20 minutes by grand taxi.

q2.question: Is Martil good for swimming?
q2.answer: Yes. It has a long public sandy beach popular for swimming in summer.

q3.question: Are there good restaurants?
q3.answer: The corniche and main streets are lined with cafés, ice-cream shops and fish restaurants.

q4.question: Is it busy in winter?
q4.answer: In winter Martil is much quieter and feels mainly like a residential seaside town.

q5.question: Can I visit on a day trip?
q5.answer: Absolutely. Most visitors explore Tetouan in the morning and head to Martil for lunch and the beach.
